request.description: Use when the admitted procedure has isPackage: true — a procedure bundle that covers bed and nursing costs internally. The patient is still assigned a bed (bedId is sent and occupation/release logic runs normally), but allowBedCharges/allowNursingCharges: false means no monetary charge is added or frozen for bed/nursing. The bed is still marked Occupied on admission and Available on discharge.

request.description:
List IPDs with pagination and filters.

**Filters:**
- status: Admitted | Discharged | LAMA | Cancelled
- doctorId: filter by doctor
- patientId: filter by patient
- bedId: filter by bed
- isDischarge: true/false
- paymentNotCleared: true — surfaces LAMA/Cancelled IPDs with outstanding dues
- search: patient name, MRD, or ipdId
- startDate / endDate: filter by admissionDate range
- date: single day filter

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('ipdId')) console.warn('[IPD] ipdId not set — run Create IPD first.');
if (r.data.visitId) pm.test('visit populated when visitId set', () => pm.expect(r.data.visit).to.have.property('visitId'));

console.log('[IPD]', r.data.ipdId, '| status:', r.data.status, '| paymentStatus:', r.data.paymentStatus, '| amountPaid:', r.data.amountPaid, '/', r.data.totalPrice, '| visitId:', r.data.visitId || 'none', '| summaryStatus:', r.data.dischargeSummary && r.data.dischargeSummary.summaryStatus || 'none');
if (r.data.bedCharge) console.log('[IPD] bedCharge — days:', r.data.bedCharge.days, '| total:', r.data.bedCharge.totalCharge);

if (r.data.nursingCharge) console.log('[IPD] nursingCharge — days:', r.data.nursingCharge.days, '| nursingChargePerDay:', r.data.nursingCharge.nursingChargePerDay, '| total:', r.data.nursingCharge.totalCharge);
else console.log('[IPD] nursingCharge: null (ward has no nursingChargePerDay or IPD is discharged — check billingCharges for frozen entry).');

request.description:
Returns fully populated IPD including:
- patient, doctor, bed+ward
- visit (if visitId was set — basic visit details)
- billingCharges (test charges include full caseData)
- bedCharge (dynamic, computed from admissionDate → dischargeSummary.dischargeDate or now)
- nursingCharge (dynamic, computed from ward.nursingChargePerDay × days; null if not configured or IPD is discharged — frozen into billingCharges instead)
- transactions, amountPaid, paymentStatus
- dischargeSummary (Draft or Finalized)
- paymentNotCleared flag

item.name: IPD — Discharge Summary (Draft)
item.description: Fill the discharge summary progressively while the patient is still admitted. All fields optional. dischargeDate lives here — set it to preview the frozen bed charge. Call as many times as needed before finalizing.

exec: console.log('[IPD] dischargeDate updated to:', r.data.dischargeSummary.dischargeDate, '| new totalPrice:', r.data.totalPrice);

request.description: Only update the dischargeDate. The live bed charge on GET will recalculate immediately.

item.name: IPD — Finalize Discharge
item.description: Finalize discharge. Checks: IPD must be Admitted, dischargeDate must be set and not in future, payment must be fully cleared (hard block). Freezes bed charge, locks summary, releases bed.

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('ipdId')) console.warn('[IPD] ipdId not set — run Create IPD first.');
pm.test('bed charge frozen in billingCharges', () => { const bc = r.data.billingCharges.find(c => c.type === 'bed'); pm.expect(bc).to.not.be.undefined; });
console.log('[IPD] Discharged:', r.data.ipdId, '| dischargeDate:', r.data.dischargeSummary.dischargeDate, '| totalPrice:', r.data.totalPrice);

request.description: Finalize discharge. dischargeDate must already be set in the discharge summary draft. Payment must be fully cleared. Optionally pass a final transaction to settle dues at the same time.

exec: console.log('[IPD] Discharged with final payment — totalPrice:', r.data.totalPrice, '| amountPaid:', r.data.amountPaid);

request.description: Pass a transaction to settle the final balance at discharge time. The transaction is created first, then payment is verified.
If there is an outstanding balance and no transaction is passed to cover it, discharge returns 400 with the due amount.
Discharge date cannot be in the future.

item.name: IPD — LAMA (Left Against Medical Advice)
item.description: Patient leaves against medical advice. No discharge summary required. Payment is NOT blocked — paymentNotCleared flag is set if dues remain. Bed charge frozen to lamaDate. Bed released.

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('ipdId')) console.warn('[IPD] ipdId not set — run Create IPD first.');
pm.test('bed charge frozen', () => { const bc = r.data.billingCharges.find(c => c.type === 'bed'); if (bc) pm.expect(bc.toDate).to.not.be.undefined; });
console.log('[IPD] LAMA:', r.data.ipdId, '| paymentNotCleared:', r.data.paymentNotCleared, '| totalPrice:', r.data.totalPrice);

request.description: Mark IPD as LAMA. lamaDate defaults to now if not provided. reason is optional. Bed charge is frozen to lamaDate.

exec: pm.test('Status 200 — LAMA proceeds despite dues', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
console.log('[IPD] LAMA with dues — paymentNotCleared:', r.data.paymentNotCleared, '| amountPaid:', r.data.amountPaid, '/', r.data.totalPrice);

request.description: LAMA proceeds even with outstanding balance. paymentNotCleared = true is set so billing staff can follow up. Use ?paymentNotCleared=true on the list endpoint to find these.

exec: console.log('[IPD] LAMA with payment — paymentNotCleared:', r.data.paymentNotCleared);

request.description: Optionally collect a payment at LAMA time. Transaction is created first, then paymentNotCleared is evaluated.

exec: pm.test('All results have paymentNotCleared = true', () => { if (r.data.ipds.length > 0) r.data.ipds.forEach(i => pm.expect(i.paymentNotCleared).to.be.true); });
console.log('[IPD] IPDs with pending payment:', r.data.pagination.total);

request.description: Filter IPDs where payment was not cleared at LAMA or Cancel time. Use this for billing follow-up.

pm.test('Test charge has totalAmount (pathlab bill total)', () => pm.expect(testCharge).to.have.property('totalAmount'));

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('ipdId')) console.warn('[IPD] ipdId not set — run Create IPD first.');

console.log('[IPD] Bed charge — ward:', bedCharge && bedCharge.wardName, '| days:', bedCharge && bedCharge.units, '| chargePerDay:', bedCharge && bedCharge.chargePerDay, '| totalCharge:', bedCharge && bedCharge.totalCharge);

else console.log('[IPD] No nursing charge (ward has no nursingChargePerDay set).');

item.name: IPD — Pathlab Case Linking
item.description: When a pathlab case is created with ipdId, it auto-pushes a test billing item to the IPD. The test charge is stored for display and bill printing only — it does NOT affect IPD subtotal or totalPrice because pathlab billing is handled independently.

item.name: Create Pathlab Case with ipdId (auto-links to IPD)

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('ipdId')) console.warn('[IPD] ipdId not set — run Create IPD first.');
// Note: record the current IPD subtotal before this call to verify it does not change after linking.
console.log('[Case] Created and linked to IPD:', pm.collectionVariables.get('ipdReadableId'), '| caseId:', caseData.caseId, '| totalAmount:', caseData.totalAmount);
console.log('[Case] Now run "Get IPD — Verify test charge and totals" to confirm IPD subtotal is unchanged.');

request.description:
Creates a pathlab case linked to an active IPD. The case service fires-and-forgets a `_linkCaseToIPD` call that appends a `type: "test"` entry to the IPD's billingCharges array.

Critically, the IPD's `subtotal` and `totalPrice` are NOT recalculated — pathlab billing is a separate concern.

item.name: Get IPD — Verify test charge and totals

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('ipdId')) console.warn('[IPD] ipdId not set — run Create IPD first.');
// Verify the test charge is present and fully populated
pm.test('Test charge auto-added from case creation', () => pm.expect(testCharge).to.not.be.undefined);
pm.test('Test charge has full caseData populated', () => pm.expect(testCharge && testCharge.caseData).to.not.be.null);
pm.test('caseData has casetests array', () => pm.expect(testCharge && testCharge.caseData && testCharge.caseData.casetests).to.be.an('array'));
// KEY ASSERTION: test charge must NOT be included in IPD totals
pm.test('IPD subtotal excludes pathlab test charges', () => pm.expect(r.data.subtotal).to.eql(expectedSubtotal));
pm.test('IPD totalPrice excludes pathlab test charges', () => pm.expect(r.data.totalPrice).to.eql(Math.max(0, expectedSubtotal - (r.data.discount || 0))));
console.log('[IPD] Test charge — caseId:', testCharge && testCharge.caseReadableId, '| pathlab totalAmount:', testCharge && testCharge.totalAmount);
console.log('[IPD] Totals (pathlab excluded) — subtotal:', r.data.subtotal, '| discount:', r.data.discount, '| totalPrice:', r.data.totalPrice);

request.description:
Verifies two things after a pathlab case is linked:
1. The `type: "test"` billing charge is present and `caseData` is fully populated (patient, casetests with test/group/category, transactions, labcenter, referring doctor).
2. The IPD `subtotal` and `totalPrice` do NOT include the pathlab case amount — they only reflect IPD charges (procedures, packages, doctor, bed, nursing).
